notes.title: DecayZ Origin – Version 0.1.2
notes.content:
[p]🛠 Improvements & Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the camera wouldn’t return to its original position after aiming and then un-aiming.

- Fixed a bug where players couldn't shoot enemies that were extremely close.

- Fixed misalignment in the inventory grid layout.

- Adjusted the gun's position on the character's back to better align with the upcoming melee system.

- Healing herbs are now highlighted for better visibility.

- Reduced damage dealt by the first boss.

- Reduced damage dealt by normal enemy.

- Reduced the damage penalty for using shotguns at long range.

- Improved visibility for the cat in the area where it is first encountered.

- Increased the layout size of the inventory and crafting slot containers for better usability.

🔄 Changes

- Removed the melee finisher (pressing F near enemies). A new melee system will replace it in a future update.

🔮 What’s Coming Next

- Melee Combat System – because sometimes, bullets just aren’t enough.

(Currently 40% complete. It’ll take time to balance and implement properly.)

💬 Developer Message

- If anyone is still out there reading this — I’d truly love to hear your thoughts. Your feedback helps guide the future of DecayZ Origin.

- If you have a moment, please consider leaving a Steam review — even a short one.

- It helps more than you think: not just to improve the game, but to keep it visible and alive.

- Let us know what you liked, what felt off, or what you’d love to see next. You’re part of this journey.

🙏 And to everyone who supported me by purchasing the game early — thank you.

🫡 Your trust means the world to me, and I won’t forget it.[/p]

notes.title: DecayZ Origin – Version 0.1.0

notes.title: DecayZ Origin – Version 0.0.3
notes.content:
🛠 Improvements & Fixes:
- Improved FPS performance in certain areas for smoother gameplay, especially on lower-end systems.
- Fixed an issue where option settings were not saving correctly.
- Adjusted the first encounter area with the cat to improve pacing and visibility
- Optimized texture loading to reduce map loading times and improve overall stability.

🔮 What's Coming Next:
- New Game Plus Mode – Replay the game with your progress carried over and new challenges awaiting.
- Unlockable Cat Skins – Complete the game to unlock new looks for your feline companion.

💬 Developer Message
If anyone is still out there reading this,
We’d truly love to hear your thoughts. Your feedback helps guide the future of DecayZ Origin.

You’re part of this journey.

notes.title: Improve overall performance
notes.content:
⚙️ Performance Improvements
Optimized overall game performance, reducing frame drops and improving stability across all hardware configurations.

Enhanced memory management and CPU utilization, resulting in smoother gameplay.

💡 Lighting Enhancements
Improved dynamic lighting quality and efficiency.

Balanced global illumination for better realism in both indoor and outdoor environments.

Fixed occasional lighting artifacts in low-light areas.

🌑 Shadow Improvements
Refined shadow rendering to improve sharpness and consistency.

Reduced shadow flickering and improved shadow transitions at various distances.

Optimized shadow calculations for better performance.
